notes.title: V1.4 Boss Rush Mode Add In
notes.content:
In this version, the work we done:
[list]
[*] Boss Rush mode added: Now you can compete with players from all over the world to beat the top 4 bosses faster!
[*] The Boss attack mode has been improved, i.e. the Boss difficulty has been increased!
[*] Fix and improve some issues.
[/list]

Thank you for your love and play, thank you for your positive feedback!
If nothing happens, this is the last major version of the game, see you in the next game!

notes.title: Fix some bugs
notes.content:
This version fix some bugs:
[list]
[*] Fixed: Attack Down sometime would not bounce up.
[*] improve: some enemy sound effect add in.
[*] Fixed: Attack Big Cactus at the last time the falling stone would case game frezze crash.
[/list]

notes.title: V1.2 Collision Improve
notes.content:
This version works as follows
[list]
[*] Optimize the game collision logic
[*] Improved character air attack down collision 
[*] Add some guidance to the home page to improve the playing experience
[/list]

Thank you for your patience and positive feedback!

notes.title: Cat Warrior V1.1 Release!
notes.content:
The V1.1 version includes the following improvements:
[list]
[*]  level selection function added, now in the map can choose different levels to challenge instead of each challenge from level one!
[*] Fixed game pause using Spaces while ESC button
[*] Fixed some issues that affected the experience
[*] Optimize some level difficulty
[/list]
